text: ゆるして　あげる　けど…　こんどこそ　おねがいを　きいて　ちょうだいね

structure.jp: ゆるして　あげる　けど…
おねがいを　きいて　ちょうだいね
structure.en: do grant my wish, all right?

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.explanation: あげる after a て-verb means doing it as a favor for someone, and can sound a little superior. ゆるして　あげる = 'I'll forgive you', as a kindness.

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.span: きいて　ちょうだい
patterns.explanation: ちょうだい after a て-verb is a casual, feminine way of saying ください 'please do it'. きいて　ちょうだい = 'please listen to it'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two halves of a sentence with 'but'. ゆるして　あげる　けど = 'I'll forgive you, but'.
